data.animaCaption: Seated sideways at the dim jazz bar in a deep wine-red backless velvet gown and black opera gloves, she slides a folded secret note beneath a crystal whiskey glass while glancing back over her bare shoulder. Warm amber bar glow outlines her velvet curve and pearl earrings against the blue night skyline.
data.promptProse: Composed across a cut-crystal glass of amber whiskey in the near foreground inside an opulent dim jazz lounge, Shiki Natsume perches sideways on a high bar stool wearing a plunging backless wine-red velvet gown with a high slit, black velvet opera gloves, and pearl drop earrings. Her dark hair is loosely pinned to expose her slender bare back and nape as one gloved hand smoothly tucks a folded slip of paper beneath the coaster toward the viewer, her golden eyes flashing cool allure over her shoulder under warm amber bar shelves and blue midnight city windows.
data.story: 萨克斯低音在半暗酒廊里缓缓流淌。换上暗红露背丝绒长裙的夏目背对吧台优雅回眸，戴着黑长手套的指尖不动声色将一张微缩纸条压在威士忌杯底推来——「目标刚进三号包厢。别盯着我后背看，收好情报去接应。」
